propositions: The deprecated jira.resolved_statuses and reconciler.resolved_statuses config keys are inert and no longer read by any code, making them candidates for hard removal once operator approval is obtained.
Two _as_str_list coercer entries in _config_schema.py for resolved_statuses must be deleted unless other callers remain.

Both removed config keys must be added as warn-class tombstones to the deprecation registry, along with their auto-derived environment variable twins, so that existing configs still load with warnings rather than errors.
The # read-via: markers, deprecation rows, and documentation references to resolved_statuses must be removed from the codebase and tests updated to reflect the removal.
All configuration, module-size, and test gates must pass after the removal to confirm no orphaned markers or unintended side effects remain.
